environment.description: Same Spring Boot 3.1 application deployed on ECS Fargate behind AWS API Gateway (HTTP API type) with a request validation model. The API Gateway integration uses a JSON Schema model bound to the POST /api/v2/reports/query route with requestValidatorId referencing a validator with validateRequestBody: true. The schema defines filterExpression as type string with maxLength: 128 and pattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.\s=<>!&|()\'\']{0,128}$' which permits only alphanumeric characters, dots, underscores, whitespace, comparison operators, logical operators, parentheses, and single quotes. The schema also enforces that sortField, userId, and department are strings matching '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_.]{0,63}$'. Requests failing schema validation receive a 400 response from the gateway before reaching the application. Note: the gateway pattern validation occurs at the API Gateway layer using AWS's built-in JSON Schema draft-04 validation engine, not application-level validation.

config.gateway: AWS API Gateway HTTP API with request body validation enabled
config.auth: OAuth2 bearer token validation via API Gateway authorizer
